description: This file provides an overview and implementation details of the Page Object Model pattern for Playwright tests, including code snippets in multiple languages illustrating how to define and use page object classes.

classes.name: PlaywrightDevPage
classes.description: A class encapsulating interactions with the Playwright.dev webpage, specifically handling navigation, linking, and content verification related to the Page Object Model documentation.

classes.name: SearchPage
classes.description: A generic page object class representing a search page, providing methods to navigate and perform search operations.

methods.name: getStarted
methods.description: Clicks on the 'Get started' link and waits for the 'Installation' header.

methods.name: pageObjectModel
methods.description: Navigates through the page to the 'Page Object Model' section.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the web browser to a specified URL (used in SearchPage).

methods.name: search
methods.description: Fills in the search term and initiates a search on the search page.
